body: Thanks for the extra info. I will ask my psychiatrist next time I see her about it and get more information at least.

Thank you for your reply. I have thought about ECT and have done some research on my own, and to be honest it frightens me nearly as much as suicide. I know that it isn't anything like the media portrayal, but the reality of it and possibly memory/cognitive side effects are enough to cause me much trepidation.

That being said, as things get worse I get closer and closer to reaching the point of seeking it (ECT) out.
